# @jeyabbalas/data-table

> Client-side TypeScript library for interactive, explorable data tables. Runs DuckDB compiled to WebAssembly directly in the browser — no server-side processing, complete data privacy. Ships per-column visualizations with brush/click crossfilter, derived columns (SQL expressions or JS value vectors), programmatic row/column/cell annotations with severity tiers + popover, structured XSS-safe column-header tooltips, custom column-stats panels via `BaseStatsPanel` + per-instance `StatsPanelRegistry`, stable synthetic `__rowid__` plus read-only column export, undo/redo, IndexedDB session persistence, WCAG-oriented accessibility, and CSV/JSON/Parquet export.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention. It is a curated index for coding agents and LLM-driven tools. Human readers should start with [README.md](./README.md).

## Start here (for agents)

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Coding-agent guide — capability matrix, clarifying-question checklist, canonical snippets, common pitfalls. Read this before writing code against the library.
- [README.md](./README.md): Feature list, install, quick start, framework integration.

## Guides (task-oriented walkthroughs)

- [docs/guides/loading-data.md](./docs/guides/loading-data.md): File / URL / Blob / ArrayBuffer ingestion, format detection, progress events.
- [docs/guides/filters.md](./docs/guides/filters.md): The seven filter types, programmatic filter construction, serialization.
- [docs/guides/derived-columns.md](./docs/guides/derived-columns.md): SQL-expression vs vector derived columns, DuckDB VIEW reconciliation, dependency-aware replacement.
- [docs/guides/annotations.md](./docs/guides/annotations.md): Programmatic row/column/cell annotation CRUD, severity filtering, intersection popover, JSON round-trip, session persistence.
- [docs/guides/column-header-tooltips.md](./docs/guides/column-header-tooltips.md): Structured popover for column-header metadata (title / description / items + enum chips), XSS-safe by construction.
- [docs/guides/events.md](./docs/guides/events.md): Full event catalog, lifecycle ordering, error discrimination.
- [docs/guides/visualizations.md](./docs/guides/visualizations.md): Built-in visualization classes and custom class registration.
- [docs/guides/stats-panels.md](./docs/guides/stats-panels.md): Replace the column-header `.dt-col-stats` slot with a `BaseStatsPanel` subclass — lifecycle, filter-aware DuckDB queries, hover integration, error surfacing.
- [docs/guides/session-persistence.md](./docs/guides/session-persistence.md): IndexedDB lifecycle, `saveSync()` for page-exit, custom stores.
- [docs/guides/theming.md](./docs/guides/theming.md): Complete `--dt-*` CSS variable reference, dark mode, per-instance overrides.
- [docs/guides/i18n.md](./docs/guides/i18n.md): `Strings` interface, `DeepPartial` overrides, function-typed strings.
- [docs/guides/accessibility.md](./docs/guides/accessibility.md): Keyboard map, ARIA surface, screen-reader testing.
- [docs/guides/multi-table.md](./docs/guides/multi-table.md): Sharing `FilterPresetManager` and `SessionStore` across instances.
- [docs/guides/csp-and-offline.md](./docs/guides/csp-and-offline.md): `workerFactory`, `workerUrl`, `duckdbBundles` for strict-CSP and offline.
- [docs/guides/filter-presets.md](./docs/guides/filter-presets.md): Save / load / export / import preset JSON.
